original_idea.body:
# Truth-Direction Geometry Under Logical Transformations

Fit truth direction on plain statements, test on negations/conjunctions, quantify drift.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: constrains ELK belief-reading, but the link to catastrophic risk is indirect.
